name: PokéDex
description: Records all encountered and captured Pokémon and fusions.

name: Oak's Parcel
description: Must be delivered to Professor Oak in Pallet Town to obtain the PokéDex.

name: DNA Splicers
description: Fuses two Pokémon or unfuses an existing fusion.

name: DNA Reverser
description: Switches the head and body of an existing fusion.

name: Poké Radar
requirement: Use DNA Splicers 5 times to get Exp Share, then assist on Route 24
description: Reveals rare exclusive species in shaking grass after route completion.

name: Bicycle
requirement: Bike Voucher from Pokémon Fan Club President in Vermilion City
description: Enables high-speed travel on land and Cycling Road.

name: S.S. Ticket
description: Boarding pass for the S.S. Anne cruise ship docked in Vermilion City.

name: Coin Case
description: Holds coins for the Celadon Game Corner prizes.

name: Super Splicers
description: Fuses Pokémon with enhanced level averaging and optimal stat inheritance.

name: Silph Scope
description: Unmasks wild ghost Pokémon in the Pokémon Tower.

name: Poké Flute
description: Awakens sleeping Pokémon, clearing Snorlax blocking Routes 12 and 16.

name: Exp. All
description: Shares battle experience points with all non-fainted party members.

name: Card Key
description: Unlocks electronic security doors throughout Silph Co. headquarters.

name: Infinite Splicers
description: Reusable infinite DNA Splicer that never depletes.

name: Box Link
description: Directly access PC storage boxes from anywhere in the overworld.
